description: The social accounts connected to this workspace: each one’s id, network, name and status. Drafts are written for these ids. An account whose status is disconnected has to be connected again on the user’s account page before anything can be posted to it.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.
